seat-count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM reservations

seats-left.sql: SELECT capacity - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE reservations.exam_id = exams.id) AS left FROM exams WHERE id = 'exam-1'

reservation-holder.sql: SELECT account FROM reservations WHERE exam_id = 'exam-1' AND account NOT IN ('holder_rc','holder2_rc') ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
